card.name: Supra- in anatomical location terms
card.fires_on: The prefix "supra" in anatomical landmark words such as supracondylar, supraorbital, supraclavicular and supra-iliac, usually after "above the". Weaker on a few other word starts like "Sup" in supraventricular.
